featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

Thinking about a Ladakh road trip planning strategy for your summer break? The secret to enjoying the Land of High Passes without the struggle of altitude sickness is a slow, steady ascent.

We suggest starting your journey from the Srinagar side and ending in Leh to help your body adjust to the elevation gradually. While everyone prioritizes Pangong Tso, make sure to add Hanle to your itinerary for some of the clearest night skies in Asia. If you are driving yourself, keep your fuel tank full at every opportunity as petrol pumps are extremely scarce once you leave the main towns. Also, remember that even in June, the wind chill at high passes like Khardung La can drop temperatures to sub-zero, so high-quality layers are a necessity.

Our curated FIT itineraries cover stays, transport, and local experiences so you can focus on the scenery rather than the logistics.

Tell us your dates — we'll plan the rest. Visit adventourist.in

Thinking about Ladakh road trip planning for the coming weeks? Most travellers focus on the high passes and bike rentals, but the real secret to a successful journey is exactly how you spend your first 48 hours after landing or arriving in Leh.

If you are currently in the middle of your Ladakh road trip planning, remember that the Manali-Leh highway is significantly more scenic but much more taxing on the body than the Srinagar route. A pro tip for photography enthusiasts is to visit the Thiksey Monastery specifically for the morning prayers at 6 AM. The rhythmic chanting provides a soul-stirring atmosphere that most visitors miss by arriving after breakfast. Also, ensure you carry a physical map or offline GPS coordinates, as data connectivity remains unpredictable once you leave the main town of Leh toward Nubra Valley.

featured_reviews.name: Marzban Hathiram
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited Leh Ladakh in end of August this year. the entire planning, logistics, hotel bookings, car rentals, itineraries etc was handled by Pinky of Adventourist. We have nothing but good things to say about this company and also Pinky. Right from the first enquiry to planning an extended trip over 10 days, going back and forth on the choice of hotels and the places to visit, Pinky was courteous, prompt, friendly and super-efficient. Her turnaround time was generally less than 2 hours. Even if it was slightly delayed, she would send a message explaining the delay and asking for time. Once we got there, our first hotel gave us a room which was not what we had asked and paid for. A simple WhatsApp message to Pinky and a few minutes later the GM came and apologized and shifted us to a much better and premium room. The car and the driver - both extremely important in Ladakh - were superb. It was a very new Innova Crysta and the driver was just too good. His driving was safe, yet fast and his manners were impeccable. He broke the monotony of long drives with his native Ladakhi wisdom and jokes. Always cleanly dressed, he would clean the entire car - inside and out once we reached the day's destination. In short, we had a great time, and it was entirely due to the proper planning and coordination by Pinky and Adventourist. They gave us a briefing before leaving to explain the dangers of Ladakh climate and how we should taje care. They kept on asking us over WhatsApp throughout the tour if everything was ok. and they even checked once we landed whether the bags were received properly. Such quality of service is very very rare in India. We are glad we chose Adventourist and we will be using them again for our future travels! Thanks Pinky for all your efforts!
